parameters.help: The parameters in box order, each with id, name and options (id, label).

id.help: The id of the parameter; the key for parameterId and for the picks of the concepts.

name.help: The name of the parameter, a sub-function or property of the solution; empty is allowed.

options.help: The options of the parameter in box order, each with id and label.

id.help: The id of the option, unique across all parameters; the value for optionId, optionA and optionB.

label.help: The label of the option; empty is allowed.

conflicts.help: The incompatible pairs as sorted pairs of option ids.

concepts.help: The concepts, each with id, name and picks (parameter id → option id).

id.help: The id of the concept; the value for conceptId.

name.help: The name of the concept; empty is allowed.

picks.help: The pick per parameter: parameter id → id of an option of that parameter. A parameter without an entry is not picked.

view.help: The view shown: "box" for the box, "consistency" for the consistency matrix.

activeConceptId.help: The concept a click in the box edits. Empty only while there are no concepts.

optionIds.help: The ids of all options in box order — the valid values for optionId, optionA and optionB.

combinationCount.help: All combinations of one option per parameter — the product of the option counts.

consistentCount.help: The combinations without an incompatible pair. For very large boxes only a lower bound; then consistentExact is false and the display reads "≥ n".

consistentExact.help: false when consistentCount is only a lower bound because the counting budget ran out.

conceptChecks.help: Per concept: id, complete (every parameter with options is picked) and conflicts (the incompatible pairs inside the concept).

read.help: Returns parameters, options, incompatibilities and concepts together with the combination counts and the concept checks.

addParameter.help: Appends a parameter (a row of the box) with one empty option and returns its id.

params.command: An empty object; the command takes no arguments.

setParameterName.help: Sets the name of a parameter.

params.parameterId: The id of the parameter. An unknown id is an error.
params.name: The new name; the empty string clears it.
params.command: The command as one object with parameterId and name.

removeParameter.help: Removes a parameter with its options, their incompatibilities and the concept picks in it.

params.parameterId: The id of the parameter. An unknown id is an error.
params.command: The command as one object with parameterId.

addOption.help: Appends an empty option to a parameter and returns its id.

params.parameterId: The id of the parameter. An unknown id is an error.
params.command: The command as one object with parameterId.

setOptionLabel.help: Sets the label of an option.

params.optionId: The id of the option. An unknown id is an error.
params.label: The new label; the empty string clears it.
params.command: The command as one object with optionId and label.

removeOption.help: Removes an option with its incompatibilities and the concept picks that point at it.

params.optionId: The id of the option. An unknown id is an error.
params.command: The command as one object with optionId.

setConflict.help: Marks two options of different parameters as incompatible, or clears the mark.

params.optionA: The id of the first option.
params.optionB: The id of the second option, from another parameter. Two options of the same parameter are an error.
params.incompatible: true marks the pair, false clears the mark.
params.command: The command as one object with optionA, optionB and incompatible.

addConcept.help: Appends an empty concept, makes it active and returns its id.

params.command: An empty object; the command takes no arguments.

setConceptName.help: Sets the name of a concept.

params.conceptId: The id of the concept. An unknown id is an error.
params.name: The new name; the empty string clears it.
params.command: The command as one object with conceptId and name.

removeConcept.help: Removes a concept; if it was active, the first remaining one becomes active.

params.conceptId: The id of the concept. An unknown id is an error.
params.command: The command as one object with conceptId.

setConceptPick.help: Picks the option of a parameter for a concept, or clears the pick.

params.optionId: The id of one of this parameter's options; the empty string clears the pick. An option of another parameter is an error.
params.command: The command as one object with conceptId, parameterId and optionId.

ConceptCheck.complete: true when every parameter with options is picked.
ConceptCheck.conflicts: The incompatible pairs inside the concept, in box order.

AgentRead.parameters: The parameters with their options, in box order.
AgentRead.optionIds: The ids of all options, in box order.
AgentRead.combinationCount: All combinations of one option per parameter.
AgentRead.consistentExact: false when consistentCount is only a lower bound.
AgentRead.conceptChecks: Per concept: id, complete and conflicts.
